# write_file_to { #crossrepo.gitutil.write_file_to }

```python
crossrepo.gitutil.write_file_to(src, dest)
```

Copy a file that git does not hold, such as a Git LFS object.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**src**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Location](`crossrepo.location.Location`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   File to read, on this machine or another.

<code>[**dest**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Path](`pathlib.Path`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   File to write. It is removed again if the copy fails.

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

<code>[:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[GitError](`crossrepo.gitutil.GitError`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   If the file cannot be read.
